property_summary: In the reference contract only the owner can successfully call burn(uint256) so any burn attempt by a non-owner must leave totalSupply equal to the caller's pre-call balance unchanged (i.e., non-owners cannot reduce totalSupply); the mutant removing onlyOwner allows non-owners to reduce totalSupply for some caller/amount, violating this rule.
change_summary: Replace the owner-only restriction so burn is callable by anyone (remove onlyOwner modifier).
